{{Youmay|the Republic squadron|[[Alpha Flight (Naboo)|Alpha Flight]], the squadron from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]}}
'''Alpha Flight''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Alpha Flight accompanied the Republic [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] [[Strike Force Cularin]] on a [[Mission to the Ando system|mission]] to attack a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Separatist Ando system base|base]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]]. On arrival in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], the Republic [[Task force/Legends|task force]] engaged a [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|Separatist Corellian corvette]]. Alpha Flight flew over to the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] and opened fire on it, causing the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to explode.<ref name="Almas">{{LivingForce|Decision: Almas}}</ref>
